source_text:
κἂν προσωποποιήσῃ τὸν προφήτην, ἢ τὸν λαὸν ἐκεῖνον, ἢ τὸν λαὸν τοῦτον, ἢ ὅ τι
δήποτε προσωποποιεῖ, τὸ ἅγιον Πνεῦμά ἐστι τὸ πάντα προσωποποιοῦν.
pass_a_gloss: even if it should personify the prophet, or that people, or this people, or whatever it personifies, the Holy Spirit is the one that personifies all things.
pass_b_english: Even when the Spirit personifies the prophet, or that people, or this people, or any other role, it is the Holy Spirit who carries out every personification.

choices.choice: Locked rem-close Greek ends the homily scrap.
Pass B keeps Origen's universal claim: every prophetic persona is the Spirit's work.
